question: Where can I get rural land prices or rural land transactions in the United States, by municipality or region and year?

answer.summary: Best source: USDA NASS. Quick Stats (public bulk file) holds survey estimates of farm real estate value per acre by state from 1850 to 2026, plus cropland and pasture, and Census of Agriculture values by county for 1997-2022; the 2026 values were released 2026-07-31. They are estimated market values, not sale prices. Recorded sales are published by states: Vermont posts quarterly sale statistics by town and category. No national sales dataset was found; tax-assessed values are different.
main_caveats: NASS values are survey-based estimates of what land 'could be sold' for; farm real estate includes buildings. They are not recorded sale prices.
Some state cells are withheld: the report shows (D) (e.g. Vermont cropland 2022-2024); the Quick Stats bulk file omits those survey rows. US totals exclude Alaska and Hawaii.
County values exist only from the Census of Agriculture (every five years; 1997-2022, 2022 latest); the annual survey is state or region level.
The Quick Stats API needs a registered key (not created here); values were reproduced from the public bulk file and the 2026 report instead.
Vermont sale statistics follow the department's 'valid sales' rule and its categories; 'Farms' rows had no per-acre figures in the 2025 and 2026 files read.
Tax-assessed (Grand List) values and listing offers are different objects and were not used as prices.
answer.confidence_reason: NASS values reproduced from bulk data and the report and agree; only one state's sales were tested; Quick Stats API and Vermont weekly data were not run.

attributes.note: NASS: estimated value in $/acre for farm real estate, cropland, pasture (survey, 'could be sold'); Vermont: recorded sale prices, some with per-acre.
Vermont publishes counts and price statistics of valid sales by town and category; weekly record data exists but was not opened. No national sales set found.
attributes.gap_note: Only Vermont was tested. Next: search other states' revenue/recorder open data; Vermont weekly blob data was not inspected.

attributes.note: NASS: national, multi-state region, state (FIPS) and county (Census years); Vermont: town and county names.
NASS YEAR with reference period (YEAR for survey, END OF DEC for Census); Vermont files state the period (YTD through quarter end).
NASS survey 2026 (released 2026-07-31); Census 2022; Vermont accumulated through 2026-09-30 (Q3 file).
NASS state survey series back to 1850 (123 years with gaps), Census 1997-2022; Vermont quarterly files from 2020 (format changed 2020).
NASS annual (observed loads 2025-08-01 and 2026-07-31), Census every five years; Vermont quarterly files and weekly public data.

sources.name: USDA NASS Quick Stats - AG LAND asset value per acre (annual survey and Census of Agriculture)
sources.format: Tab-delimited text in a gzip bulk file; web query tool; API (JSON/XML/CSV) with a registered key
sources.license: Unknown (NASS Terms of Service apply to the API)
sources.summary: NASS Quick Stats carries farm real estate, cropland and pasture value per acre by state (survey, 1850-2026) and by county (Census, 1997-2022), downloadable without an account.
sources.coverage_note: State/region annual; county only in Census years; Alaska and Hawaii not in US totals.
caveats: Withheld cells; API needs a key.

problems: Quick Stats API needs a registered key and was not run; an unauthenticated call returned HTTP 401 {"error":["unauthorized"]}.

The whole gzip (584,652,415 bytes) was streamed and rows containing 'AG LAND' were kept; records_total counts the farm real estate $/acre series (Census county 18,460; Census state 9,332; Census national 191; survey state 5,880; survey region 400; survey national 123).
Withheld survey cells (e.g. Delaware 2024) are absent from the bulk file but printed as (D) in the PDF report.

example.example_request: curl -sSL 'https://www.nass.usda.gov/sites/default/files/datasets/qs.economics_20261120.txt.gz' | gunzip -c | awk -F'\t' 'NR==1 || ($10=="AG LAND, INCL BUILDINGS - ASSET VALUE, MEASURED IN $ / ACRE" && $1=="SURVEY" && $13=="STATE" && $16=="VT" && $31==2026)'   # columns 1 SOURCE_DESC, 10 SHORT_DESC, 13 AGG_LEVEL_DESC, 16 STATE_ALPHA, 31 YEAR
example.example_result: Vermont, 2026, farm real estate incl. buildings: VALUE 4,490 ($/acre), annual, reference period YEAR; same figure in NASS Land Values 2026 Summary. Census 2022 Addison County VT: 3,832 $/acre, CV 9.0.

sources.name: USDA NASS Land Values 2026 Summary (annual report)
sources.summary: The 2026 report gives average value per acre of farm real estate, cropland and pasture by state; values are survey-based estimates.
sources.coverage_note: States and regions except Alaska and Hawaii; (D) cells withheld.
caveats: Estimated market value, not sale price.

problems: The methodology document named in the report (landqm25.pdf) returned HTTP 404 on www.nass.usda.gov and on data.nass.usda.gov.
www.nass.usda.gov/Publications/Todays_Reports/reports/land0726.txt returned 404; the ESMIS copy was used (the release PDF is 1,347,863 bytes).

sources.name: Vermont Property Transfer Tax statistics (quarterly town and county workbooks; weekly public data)
sources.format: XLSX workbooks (sheets Report, GrandList Categories, Data); weekly data in a blob web app; PDFs for 2010-2015
sources.summary: Vermont's tax department publishes sale statistics by town and category, including Farms, Woodland and Miscellaneous, in quarterly workbooks.
sources.coverage_note: Vermont only; 258 area names in the 2026 Q3 file (including a STATE row); cumulative through 2026-09-30.

problems: The weekly public data is a JavaScript 'Blob Browser' app on a third-party host; only its shell was loaded.
Per-acre statistics are blank for Farms and for residential 6+ acre rows in the files read.
records_total = data rows of the 2026 Q3 Data sheet (excluding the header rows).

example.example_request: curl -sSL -o vt_ptt_2026q3_town.xlsx 'https://tax.vermont.gov/sites/tax/files/documents/PTT%20CY2026%20Q3%20town.xlsx'   # then open sheet 'Data', filter PropertyCategory=14 (Woodland) and a town
example.example_result: 2026 Q3 file: state row 21,155 transfers, 10,126 valid sales; Woodland 115 town rows, 290 valid sales, 73 rows with an average per acre; Farms 87 rows, 132 valid sales, none with per-acre.
